end_run_text_initial: Card pool expands. Run 2 starts now.
cycle_legacy_goldilocks_reached:
[color=#51cf66][b]DEFINING GAME[/b][/color]
Amb · Inst · Soul — all hit.
cycle_legacy_goldilocks_missed:
[color=#ffd43b][b]CYCLE COMPLETE[/b][/color]
No Defining Game. Cycle resets.
jank_polished_flavor: Clean build. Low jank. Fans may miss the weirdness.
jank_broken_flavor: Barely functional. Players are committed anyway.
jank_defining_game_note: Only your studio could have made this.
roulette_intro_surprise_hit: Nobody saw it coming. Neither did you.
roulette_intro_cult_classic: The score desk is confused. The fans already know.
roulette_intro_legendary_jank: Damage reports and recommendations. Same paragraph.
epilogue_surprise_hit: Sequel meeting booked before post-mortems are in.
epilogue_defining_game: It limps, it sings, it won't be forgotten.
epilogue_cult_classic: Every broken interaction preserved like holy text.
epilogue_legendary_jank: A speedrunner already swore loyalty to the crash pattern.
epilogue_financial_catastrophe: Ruinous. The studio calls tomorrow a strategy.
epilogue_cult_disaster: Recovery slow. Someone's writing an essay about what it tried to do.
epilogue_prestige_collapse: Everything works. The soul is pacing outside.
choice_runway_warning: WARNING: Some options cut RUNWAY DAYS (%d).
ending_desc_defining_game: Defining Game: ambitious, janky, made with love.
ending_desc_cult_disaster: Cult Disaster: too broken, too little soul.
ending_desc_legendary_jank: Legendary Jank: broke everything, became folklore.
ending_desc_cult_classic: Cult Classic: bugs preserved, community eternal.
ending_desc_financial_catastrophe: Financial Catastrophe: nothing worth rating shipped.
ending_desc_prestige_collapse: Prestige Collapse: all systems nominal, soul absent.
ending_desc_shipped_something: Shipped Something: not legendary, not a disaster.
archetype_dialog_intro:
[b]What are you making?[/b]

Seeds the run. Matching cards place clean. Off-genre cards add Instability — and sometimes useful jank.
archetype_dialog_no_archetype_note: [i]No archetype: all cards neutral, no mismatch.[/i]
